verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack says what happens when a ScrapingBee plan's monthly credits run out, whether overage billing or a hard cutoff. The Usage API (real-time credit and concurrency reads), the 1,000 free credits, and auto mode's charge-only-on-success rule are related billing features, but none of them documents behavior past the plan limit.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether exceeding my plan's monthly credit or request quota triggers overage charges or a hard cutoff
